Metadata.Goal: 为 AICtrlWorkflow 与 AIDataWorkflow 提供 canonical XNL profile source loaders。
Metadata.Description: 复用 ctrl/eager-data substrate parsing 与 validation，返回 typed AI workflow binding 和结构化诊断。

TaskSpace.name: add-ai-workflow-profile-source-loaders
TaskSpace.Description: Canonical AI workflow profile source loaders over existing substrate parsers.

TaskGroup.name: Substrate profile-root primitives
TaskGroup.Description: Add explicit profile-root loading paths while preserving existing substrate loader behavior.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Existing substrate loader characterization tests pass
Profile roots lower through the same grammar and validation rules

Task.name: Add ctrl profile-root source loading primitive
Task.Description: Parameterize ctrl source loading for an explicit profile root and WorkCtrlFlow target without widening the existing loader.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: AICtrlWorkflow sources can be validated with WorkCtrlFlow grammar and lowered to a WorkCtrlFlow spec
Existing InstantCtrlFlow/WorkCtrlFlow/BPCtrlFlow loader tests remain unchanged and pass

Task.name: Add eager-data profile-root source loading primitive
Task.Description: Parameterize eager-data source loading for an explicit AIDataWorkflow root without widening the existing loader.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: AIDataWorkflow sources reuse EagerDataFlow node, port, contract and DAG validation
Existing EagerDataFlow loader tests remain unchanged and pass

TaskGroup.name: AI workflow loader facades
TaskGroup.Description: Expose typed public source loaders from AI workflow logic packages.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Both AI workflow logic packages export canonical loaders
Invalid sources return diagnostics without executable bindings

Task.name: Add AICtrlWorkflow loader facade
Task.Description: Load canonical sources, lower through the ctrl primitive and wrap the result as an AICtrlWorkflow definition binding.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Canonical ai-ctrl-workflow example loads with no diagnostics and a WorkCtrlFlow-backed binding
Wrong roots and invalid statements produce stable diagnostics and no binding

Task.name: Add AIDataWorkflow loader facade
Task.Description: Load canonical sources, lower through the eager-data primitive and wrap the result as an AIDataWorkflow definition binding.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Canonical ai-data-workflow example loads with no diagnostics and an EagerDataFlow-backed binding
Wrong roots and invalid nodes produce stable diagnostics and no binding

TaskGroup.name: Compatibility and release readiness
TaskGroup.Description: Validate exports, package tests and workspace compatibility for downstream host consumption.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Affected package tests and workspace typecheck pass
Public browser entrypoints expose the source loaders

Task.name: Run compatibility and package export verification
Task.Description: Run affected and workspace checks, verify browser exports and record evidence for downstream binding.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Affected package tests and typecheck pass
Package entrypoints expose both canonical loader APIs
